init_LabgraphMonitor: create a LabgraphMonitor instance with an lg.Graph object to monitor graph topology
stream_graph_topology: run the stream_graph_topology method to stream graph topology via WebSockets
stream_real_time_graph: run the stream_real_time_graph method to stream graph topology and real-time messages via WebSockets
generate_graph_topology: build a graph topology from an lg.Graph using generate_graph_topology for WebSocket streaming
run_topology: run the run_topology function to serve generated graph topology data over WebSockets
